name: KRWQ
oneLiner: KRWQ is a Korean won stablecoin issued against USDC, frxUSD, and Korean Treasury Bonds; KYC-gated and not offered to South Korean residents.
collateral: Mixed reserves transitioning from USDC-only toward a target mix dominated by short-term Korean Treasury Bonds. Current composition includes USDC (Circle), Frax frxUSD, and tokenized Korean Treasury Bonds issued via Etherfuse's Stablebond framework and held in segregated, bankruptcy-remote custody at Shinhan Securities.
pegMechanism: Centralized issuance against a 100% reserve. Mint and redemption are gated to KYC-verified institutional counterparties (exchanges, market makers, OTC desks). Ethereum is the canonical mint chain; Base and other destinations share unified supply via LayerZero OFT v2. KRWQ is not offered to South Korean residents pending domestic stablecoin legislation under the Korean National Assembly.

notices.message: KRWQ is KYC-gated to institutional counterparties (exchanges, market makers, OTC desks) and is not currently offered to South Korean residents pending domestic stablecoin legislation under the Korean National Assembly.

notices.title: No public audit yet
notices.message: Issuer commits to monthly third-party attestations starting 2025 but has not named an auditor or published a report. Proof-of-reserves is currently a self-reported on-chain dashboard.

mintAuthority.summary: KRWQ issuance (canonical on Ethereum) is restricted to KYC-verified institutional counterparties — exchanges, market makers, and integrated partners — minting 1:1 against reserves; unified cross-chain supply propagates via LayerZero OFT v2 burn-and-mint.

controls.label: KRWQ issuer mint (whitelisted institutions)
controls.evidence: IQ (BrainDAO), with Frax, runs a controlled mint/redeem framework: only KYC'd eligible counterparties (exchanges, market makers, integrated partners) can mint/redeem KRWQ 1:1 against won reserves; Ethereum is the canonical mint chain.

controls.label: LayerZero OFT v2 cross-chain transport
controls.evidence: KRWQ uses LayerZero's OFT v2 standard: cross-chain movement burns on the source chain and mints 1:1 on the destination, giving a single unified asset rather than wrapped variants; the OFT mint is transport, not new issuance.

review.evidence: IQ/LayerZero materials describe KRWQ as a fiat-backed token with mint/redeem limited to KYC'd institutional counterparties on the canonical Ethereum chain, and a burn-and-mint LayerZero OFT v2 standard for cross-chain unified supply. No public permissionless mint exists.
